query:
SELECT olfactiveProfile, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM molecules 
WHERE olfactiveProfile IS NOT NULL AND olfactiveProfile != '' 
GROUP BY olfactiveProfile 
ORDER BY count DESC 
LIMIT 20;
